notes: v1.7.0 — Today's direction, a new line in Guard's Hard limits: set Long only or Short only for the trading day, on all instruments or one. A new entry the other way is cancelled; if it fills before the cancel lands, Guard closes right away only what that order opened. Closing or reducing is never blocked and a position you already held is never closed. It can only be made stricter during the day and clears at 5 PM New York. Includes the 1.6.1 fixes for locks that run past 5 PM New York.
